_comment: Flashcards de la Parte 3 del NIE.

cards.back: Dishonestly appropriates property belonging to another with intention of permanently depriving
(a) legal right (b) owner would consent (c) owner can't be found by reasonable steps
May be dishonest even if willing to pay
Any assumption of the rights of an owner (Morris); consent irrelevant (Lawrence, Gomez, Hinks)
Good-faith purchaser for value doesn't steal by keeping
Money, real/personal, things in action, intangible; limits: land, wild plants (commercial), wild creatures; not information (Oxford v Moss)
Possession/control/proprietary interest; s. 5(3) obligation to deal; s. 5(4) mistake + obligation to restore
Treat as own to dispose of; borrowing only if equivalent to outright taking (Lloyd – goodness/virtue)
Taking a conveyance without consent – no ITPD – summary
Aggravated vehicle-taking: dangerous driving, injury, damage to property or vehicle
Abstracting electricity
TA 1978 s. 3: payment on the spot required; dishonestly makes off; intent to avoid payment
Not at place of abode; article for burglary or theft
Enters building/part as trespasser WITH INTENT to steal, inflict GBH or do unlawful damage
Having entered as trespasser, steals/attempts or inflicts/attempts GBH
Effective entry (Brown); partial enough (Ryan)
Walkington – behind a shop counter
Is a building even if nobody there (s. 9(4))
Jones and Smith – entering for unlawful purpose = trespasser
Knowing or reckless as to entering without permission
Dwelling 14 years; other buildings 10 years
Steals + force/fear of force then and there + immediately before/at the time + in order to steal
No theft (honest belief in right) = no robbery
Minimal force (jostling) can be enough
Wrenching a bag from the hand = force on the person
Appropriation can be continuing – force after taking but still in the house
Of force THEN AND THERE; seeking to put in fear is enough

cards.front: Force used only to escape after theft
cards.back: Usually not robbery (theft + assault)
Assault with intent to rob – indictable only, life
Indictable only; life
